message: Refactor this method to reduce its Cognitive Complexity from 15 to the 15 allowed.
description: "isValid" combines a loop with four levels of nested "if"/"else" branching, each adding to the method's Cognitive Complexity. It should be refactored, e.g. by using early "continue"/guard clauses and extracting the per-item validation logic into a separate method, so the control flow is flatter and easier to follow.
